title: Retire the build-progress frame from the spec now that no consumer reads it (build retirement, cloud#5024)
body:
epic:#5024#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPTfYJJKJmzZ3By7a7

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task (build retirement epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5024) · Source: contract review S3 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#37720 (comment 7206932534).
Grade: p2 · area:ai · domain:spec · Task · evidence: read (PR #37720 head 18cec5f4)

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：spec 里的 build 进度帧（`build-progress.zod.ts`）原来的唯一消费方是刚删掉的 build 对话前端，现在没有任何代码读它，按 enforce-or-remove 退役。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Current state
- `packages/spec/src/ai/build-progress.zod.ts` names `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` `mapMessages.ts` / `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` as its consumer; objectstack-ai/objectstack#37720 deleted that code, and nothing in the repo reads `BUILD_PROGRESS_FRAME_TYPE` any more. The cloud producer is deleted by objectstack-ai/cloud#5046.

## Do
1. Premise: exact-name grep for every export of the file over this repo and the pinned cloud tree; confirm zero readers.
2. Retire it per the `spec-property-retirement` playbook (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; liveness ledger, generated baselines, ADR-0087 conversion, changeset).
3. ⛔ Order after objectstack-ai/cloud#5046 if cloud still produces the frame at that time.

## Acceptance
- No export of `build-progress.zod.ts` remains or is referenced; the spec gates and baselines green.
